text:
Samir Reddy: Heads-up — Verdant Analytics is asking for a Dedicated commit in US-EAST + eu-west. They want a 'slotted' buffer policy (reserved + scheduled bursts). Meeting with their infra lead tomorrow.
Priya Nair: What's their current p95 token load? Need to map to GPU hours before proposing slots.
Alex Chen: From initial usage logs they average ~1800 rps (short chats) at peak hour in US-EAST; eu-west is smaller (~400 rps). I'm estimating raw GPU-hours: ~2200 hrs/month for US-East if we don't batch aggressively.
Marta Gomez: Also they want 12 months term. Finance needs the Commit kPI to compute ARR impact before legal.
Samir Reddy: They proposed a baseline commit of 1500 GPU-hours/mo + a 25% buffer for burst. Asking if that's too conservative.
Tony Li: 25% buffer seems ok but depends on effective batching. If we can increase batching factor from 1.3 -> 1.8 for their traffic, effective hours drop ~30%.
Alex Chen: Quick calc:
```text
baseline = 1500
buffer = baseline * 0.25 = 375
total = 1875 GPU-hours
if batching factor improves 1.3 -> 1.8, effective = total * (1.3/1.8) ≈ 1356
```
So their ask could be reduced if we commit to a batching migration timeline.
Priya Nair: Can we offer a slotted policy: baseline 1300 hrs guaranteed, monthly reconciliation with 2x burst slots up to 1900 hrs, and auto-scaling fallback to on-demand beyond that? Need legal/ops to ok bursting policy.
Marta Gomez: That reconciliation + true-up billing is acceptable. We should include a 3% discount on overage if they convert to annual prepay.
Samir Reddy: I'll take that to Verdant. @capacity-bot can you run a 6-month projection with seasonal multipliers +10% in Nov/Dec and -15% in Jul for this tenant?
capacity-bot: Projection job queued: run_id=proj-1992003456-1. ETA ~15m. (This is an automated message)
Tony Li: Also flag network constraints — eu-west racks are on different switch fabric; we should reserve local capacity there to avoid cross-region egress for KV cache. @Priya follow up?
Priya Nair: Noted. I'll schedule a short sync with netops and put together a proposal doc with exact hour tiers + failure fallback (regional failover -> degrade to smaller model).
Samir Reddy: Thanks all, will update post-meeting. :thumbsup:
